answer: A Bristol Bay drift permit makes each extra identity pay $154,600, the CFEC estimate for 2025; a farm running N fakes pays N×$154,600 and cannot share it because one permit number names one holder in the register and the cap is fixed at 1,858. A farm cloning one permit number dies by register check at 2: the duplicate filing cancels both seats at once. The fleet fishes the river mouths where the delta meets the sea, each boat on the horizon carrying its own number. 500 seats need 500 permits and $77.3 million locked up before one fake earns.
